title: UnreachableError

connectionId.description: The connection the key manager was asked for.

details.description: What the key manager or the environment said behind the plain message, one line each, for Details: addresses, paths, HTTP statuses and system error codes. Absent when there is nothing more.

description: The key manager could not be reached, or answered that it could not answer now: nothing was changed. The message says what failed in plain words; data names the connection, and its details the raw words.
